QuestInfo.name: Never Forget
QuestInfo.0: Tumbleweed says that it will take days to get to Pantheon, but he gave you a shortcut in the form of a Pantheon Return Scroll.
QuestInfo.1: Tumbleweed says using the scroll will take you straight to Pantheon so you can talk to his friend Cartalion. Use the scroll.
QuestInfo.2: Wow, that was super fast! So, this is Pantheon?

0.0: I told you to wait a couple of days for me! But I guess you're busy. Are you leaving?

yes.0: Here, take this scroll. You can use this to jump straight to Pantheon, and when you get there talk to #rCartalion#k. Tell him I sent ya.

no.0: Good. I wouldn't mind a buddy to chat with on my trip.

default.0: Use the #bPantheon Return Scroll#k to go. Make sure you talk to #rCartalion#k, he and I are best buddies.
